new_nominal_sections.name: new H2 metal pressure-plate web
new_nominal_sections.note: 2 mm stainless plate; holes are outside this web section. Not a thin FDM edge.

scope: Every exported structure/rotor/shell. Exact manifold sections rasterized in principal coordinates, Euclidean erosion 0.5/0.75 mm, 6-neighbour cores. Detects narrow bridges between substantial regions, not a proof of stiffness, minimum wall, FDM anisotropy, fatigue or inter-part fastener adequacy. No pass inferred from mesh watertightness.
